How We Work

From Nature to Nourishment

Carefully sourced. Thoughtfully processed. Naturally yours.

01

Procure

We buy fresh mushrooms, vegetables, greens and grains straight from farms we trust.

02

Clean

Everything is washed and sorted by hand, and anything below standard is set aside.

03

Dry

Ingredients are dried slowly at low heat, so colour and nutrition stay in.

04

Cut

Dried ingredients are cut and broken down evenly, ready for milling.

05

Grind and Mix

They are milled into fine powder, or ground and blended into premixes.

06

Quality Check

Every batch is checked for taste, texture, colour and hygiene.

07

Pack and Deliver

Packed fresh and sealed, then sent to homes and bulk buyers.

See the full process

The processing journey, category by category

Vegetable Drying and Powder Processing

Raw Vegetables → Dried Ingredients → Fine Powder.

Mushroom Processing

Fresh Mushrooms → Cleaning → Drying → Mushroom Powder, where applicable.

Premix Preparation

Ingredient Selection → Preparation → Grinding and Mixing → Packaging.

Our Story

More Than Food. A Connection to Nature.

Organiva is a natural food brand built around three everyday ranges: organic vegetable and fruit powders, mushrooms, and instant premixes.

Organiva was started by people who wanted everyday food to stay close to where it comes from. We began with a small range we were happy to serve at our own table.

The range has grown one category at a time, and the approach has stayed the same: good ingredients, handled with care.

Mission

To make naturally good food easier to bring home.

Vision

Kitchens where good ingredients and convenience go together.

Commitment to quality

We aim for the same care in every pack we send out.

Philosophy

Stay close to nature, and keep things simple.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What product categories does Organiva offer?

Three: organic vegetable and fruit powders, organic mushrooms, and instant premixes.

What pack sizes are available?

Pack sizes are listed on each product page. For larger quantities, use the Bulk and Wholesale enquiry.

How do I order for my home?

Browse our products, choose a pack size and add it to your cart. Online payment is being set up; until then you can send your cart to us on WhatsApp from the checkout page.

How do bulk and wholesale orders work?

Fill in the wholesale enquiry form with the products and quantities you need. It opens WhatsApp with your details written out, and we continue the conversation there.

Which products are available right now?

Availability can vary. Message us on WhatsApp to confirm before you order.

Where do you deliver?

Delivery areas and timelines are confirmed when you place your order.

How should I store the products?

Storage instructions are printed on each pack and listed on each product page. As a guide, keep powders and dried products cool and dry, and keep fresh mushrooms refrigerated.

Can I return a product?

If something is wrong with your order, contact us and we will help put it right. See the Return and Refund Policy for details.
